chapter: Trumpet players of the old days
title: Jimmy Strode, old man Barbarin and the DuPas brothers
summary: Brief remarks on Jimmy Strode, Barbarin, and Dave and Rudolph DuPas.

story.theme_name: Trombonists: who they heard, admired and learned from
story.community_name: Talking trombonists: who played the slide and how

blocks.x: Like Jimmy Strode, you never heard of him?
I've heard of him, but don't know anything about him.

Well, he was a fellow who used to play that trumpet, and he had all them got beats about him. Old man Barbara, you heard him, I'll have to tell you about him. I know you're old boy. He was a nice musician too.
Well, there was Joe Johnson. I knew Bunk Johnson very well. Did you get to hear him when you were a kid?
Yeah, I don't know. He used to play the Eagles band. He used to play a person, and he had Dave the Pass play clarinet with him, Dave. I know all the pass, that's Rudolph, his brother.
Oh yes, I knew that they were related, because I got a picture of Arnold, DuPas, Rudolph. Well, I know I played the drum.
